title: Coches empujan al jugador + daño en piernas + caja se cae + HUD lesiones + puño limitado
request: El usuario pide que los coches empujen al jugador si esta en su camino y que la caja se pueda caer. EventService v2: el evento Caos de trafico ahora llama HazardService.Push (empujon fuerte en la direccion del coche, fuerza 55), InjuryService.Damage piernas +30, y la caja se cae con 60% de probabilidad (DeliveryService.DropPackage). HazardService v4: nueva util Push (impulso fuerte con componente vertical). RigCombatService v2: con brazos >=75% de daño no puedes golpear (lo pide el sistema de lesiones de cmd_000076). HUD v2: indicador de lesiones bajo la barra de stamina (🦵/💪/🧠 con %, visible desde 20%).

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- EVENT SERVICE · eventos ocasionales de la ciudad
-- 🌧️ Tormenta · 🚦 Caos de tráfico · 🌑 Blackout · 🌀 Paradox
-- 🚧 Construction · 👻 Anomalía
-- v2: los coches EMPUJAN al jugador, dañan sus piernas y la
--     caja puede caerse (60%).
-- Los coches y las cajas usan modelos de ServerStorage/DeliveryModels
-- (o bloques placeholder si no hay plantilla).
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DeliveryShared")
local CityEvents = require(Shared.CityEvents)
local Remotes = require(Shared.Remotes)

local Server = script.Parent
local HazardService = require(Server.HazardService)
local DeliveryService = require(Server.DeliveryService)
local EntitySpawner = require(Server.EntitySpawner)
local InjuryService = require(Server.InjuryService)

local EventService = {}
local rng = Random.new()

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Implementación de cada evento (devuelve función de reversión)
------------------------------------------------------------
local activators = {}

-- 🌧️ TORMENTA: niebla densa y ambiente oscuro
activators.Storm = function()
	local old = {
		FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
		FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
		OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
	}
	Lighting.FogStart = 0
	Lighting.FogEnd = 260
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 82)
	return function()
		Lighting.FogStart = old.FogStart
		Lighting.FogEnd = old.FogEnd
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = old.OutdoorAmbient
	end
end

-- 🌑 BLACKOUT: se apagan las luces
activators.Blackout = function()
	local old = {
		ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
		OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
		Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
	}
	Lighting.ClockTime = 0
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 22)
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 30)
	local lights = {}
	for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("StreetLight")) do
		local light = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
		if light and light.Enabled then
			light.Enabled = false
			table.insert(lights, light)
		end
	end
	return function()
		Lighting.ClockTime = old.ClockTime
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = old.OutdoorAmbient
		Lighting.Ambient = old.Ambient
		for _, light in ipairs(lights) do
			if light.Parent then light.Enabled = true end
		end
	end
end

-- 🚦 CAOS DE TRÁFICO: coches bloqueando las calles
activators.TrafficChaos = function(duration)
	local pathsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("TrafficPaths")
	local conns = {}
	if pathsFolder then
		for _, path in ipairs(pathsFolder:GetChildren()) do
			local a = path:FindFirstChild("A")
			local b = path:FindFirstChild("B")
			if a and b then
				for i = 1, 2 do
					local startCF = CFrame.new(a.Position:Lerp(b.Position, rng:NextNumber()))
					local car = EntitySpawner.Spawn("TrafficCar", {
						WaypointA = a.Position,
						WaypointB = b.Position,
						Speed = 32,
						LifeTime = duration,
					}, startCF)
					table.insert(conns, car:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CaughtTick"):Connect(function()
						local plr = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(car:GetAttribute("CaughtUserId") or 0)
						if plr and car.PrimaryPart then
							-- 🚗 el coche EMPUJA al jugador en su dirección, le daña
							-- las piernas y la caja puede salir volando (60%)
							HazardService.Push(plr, car.PrimaryPart.Position, 55)
							InjuryService.Damage(plr, "Legs", 30)
							if rng:NextNumber() < 0.6 then
								DeliveryService.DropPackage(plr, "car")
							end
						end
					end))
					Debris:AddItem(car, duration)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return function()
		for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
			c:Disconnect()
		end
	end
end

-- 🌀 PARADOX: una parte de la ciudad cambia (se abre una ruta bloqueada)
activators.Paradox = function()
	local gate
	for _, inst in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("ParadoxGate")) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
			gate = inst
			break
		end
	end
	local oldAmbient = Lighting.Ambient
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 170)
	if not gate then
		return function() Lighting.Ambient = oldAmbient end
	end
	local oldCF, oldTrans, oldCollide = gate.CFrame, gate.Transparency, gate.CanCollide
	gate.CanCollide = false
	local tween = TweenService:Create(gate, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		CFrame = oldCF * CFrame.new(0, 16, 0),
		Transparency = 0.6,
	})
	tween:Play()
	return function()
		Lighting.Ambient = oldAmbient
		if gate.Parent then
			local back = TweenService:Create(gate, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
				CFrame = oldCF,
				Transparency = oldTrans,
			})
			back:Play()
			back.Completed:Connect(function()
				if gate.Parent then gate.CanCollide = oldCollide end
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- 🚧 CONSTRUCTION: aparecen obstáculos… y una rampa (nueva ruta)
activators.Construction = function(duration)
	local spawned = {}
	for _, node in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("ConstructionNode")) do
		if node:IsA("BasePart") then
			-- dos cajas obstáculo (plantilla "Crate" o bloque placeholder)
			for i = 1, 2 do
				local crate = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Crate", nil,
					node.CFrame * CFrame.new(rng:NextNumber(-6, 6), 2, rng:NextNumber(-6, 6)))
				table.insert(spawned, crate)
				Debris:AddItem(crate, duration)
			end
			-- una rampa = nueva ruta temporal
			local ramp = Instance.new("WedgePart")
			ramp.Name = "ConstructionRamp"
			ramp.Size = Vector3.new(8, 5, 10)
			ramp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 155)
			ramp.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
			ramp.Anchored = true
			ramp.CFrame = node.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 12) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(rng:NextInteger(0, 3) * 90), 0)
			ramp.Parent = workspace
			table.insert(spawned, ramp)
			Debris:AddItem(ramp, duration)
		end
	end
	return function()
		for _, p in ipairs(spawned) do
			if p.Parent then p:Destroy() end
		end
	end
end

-- 👻 ANOMALÍA: algo persigue a los repartidores
activators.Anomaly = function(duration)
	HazardService.SpawnAnomaly(duration)
	return function() end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUCLE DE EVENTOS (ocasionales: cada 75-140 s)
------------------------------------------------------------
function EventService.Start()
	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(30) -- respiro inicial
		while true do
			local def = CityEvents.Pick(rng)
			local activate = activators[def.Id]
			if activate then
				local revert = activate(def.Duration)
				Remotes.EventAnnounce:FireAllClients(def.Icon, def.Name, def.Desc, def.Duration)
				print("[Evento] " .. def.Name .. " (" .. def.Duration .. "s)")
				task.delay(def.Duration, function()
					pcall(revert)
				end)
			end
			task.wait(rng:NextNumber(75, 140))
		end
	end)
end

return EventService

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- HAZARD SERVICE · peligros que interrumpen tu ruta
-- 🐕 perros · 🦹 ladrones · 🚁 drones · 🐔 pollo · 👻 anomalía
-- v4: nueva util Push (empujón fuerte con componente vertical,
--     lo usan los coches del evento Caos de tráfico).
-- v3: los ladrones se clonan desde la PLANTILLA SEGURA
--     (ServerStorage/ThiefRigTemplate; respaldo Workspace.Rig).
--
-- Cada peligro es un MODELO (ServerStorage/DeliveryModels/<Tipo>)
-- con comportamiento autocontenido (Behaviors/<Tipo>). Si la
-- plantilla no existe o está vacía, se usan bloques placeholder.
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local Server = script.Parent
local EconomyService = require(Server.EconomyService)
local DeliveryService = require(Server.DeliveryService)
local EntitySpawner = require(Server.EntitySpawner)

local HazardService = {}
local rng = Random.new()
local activeCounts = {} -- [player] = peligros activos

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Utilidades
------------------------------------------------------------

-- Hace tropezar al jugador (sin daño)
function HazardService.Trip(player, sourcePos)
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not hum then return end
	local dir = (hrp.Position - sourcePos)
	dir = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	if dir.Magnitude < 0.01 then dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
	dir = dir.Unit + Vector3.new(0, 0.7, 0)
	hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
	hrp:ApplyImpulse(dir * hrp.AssemblyMass * 22)
end

-- 🚗 EMPUJA fuerte al jugador alejándolo del origen (coches)
function HazardService.Push(player, sourcePos, force)
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not hum then return end
	local dir = hrp.Position - sourcePos
	dir = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	if dir.Magnitude < 0.01 then dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
	dir = dir.Unit
	hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
	hrp:ApplyImpulse((dir + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)) * hrp.AssemblyMass * (force or 55))
end

local function rootPos(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return hrp and hrp.Position or nil
end

local function randomSpawnPos(center, minR, maxR)
	local angle = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
	local dist = rng:NextNumber(minR, maxR)
	return center + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * dist, 0, math.sin(angle) * dist)
end

local function count(player, delta)
	activeCounts[player] = math.max(0, (activeCounts[player] or 0) + delta)
end

-- Escucha el atributo de salida "CaughtTick" del modelo
local function watchCaught(model, fn)
	local conn
	conn = model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CaughtTick"):Connect(function()
		fn(model:GetAttribute("CaughtUserId"))
	end)
	model.Destroying:Connect(function()
		conn:Disconnect()
	end)
end

-- 🦹 plantilla del ladrón: PRIMERO la segura en ServerStorage
local function thiefTemplate()
	local store = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local safe = store:FindFirstChild("ThiefRigTemplate")
	if safe and safe:IsA("Model") and safe:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
		return safe
	end
	local rig = workspace:FindFirstChild("Rig")
	if rig and rig:IsA("Model") and rig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
		return rig
	end
	return nil
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🐕 PERRO: persigue, hace tropezar y suelta el paquete
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.SpawnDog(player)
	local pos = rootPos(player)
	if not pos then return end
	count(player, 1)
	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Dog", {
		TargetUserId = player.UserId, Speed = 22, CatchDist = 3.5, LifeTime = 18,
	}, CFrame.new(randomSpawnPos(pos, 22, 30)))
	model.Destroying:Connect(function() count(player, -1) end)
	watchCaught(model, function(userId)
		local p = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		if p and model.PrimaryPart then
			HazardService.Trip(p, model.PrimaryPart.Position)
			DeliveryService.DropPackage(p, "dog")
		end
	end)
	DeliveryService.Popup(player, "Info", "🐕 DOG ATTACK", { "¡Un perro te persigue!" })
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🦹 LADRÓN: un clon del Rig (RigThief). Te persigue con
--    animación, roba dinero o la caja… y puedes eliminarlo
--    (puño con F o espada).
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.SpawnThief(player)
	local pos = rootPos(player)
	if not pos then return end
	local template = thiefTemplate()
	if template then
		-- clon dirigido: más agresivo que los ladrones ambientales
		local clone = template:Clone()
		clone.Name = "RigThief_Hunter"
		clone:SetAttribute("SightRange", 80)  -- te detecta desde lejos
		clone:SetAttribute("Wander", false)   -- va directo a por ti
		clone:SetAttribute("Speed", 22)
		clone:PivotTo(CFrame.new(randomSpawnPos(pos, 24, 32)))
		local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("RigThieves")
		if not folder then
			folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = "RigThieves"
			folder.Parent = workspace
		end
		clone.Parent = folder
		Debris:AddItem(clone, 45)
		DeliveryService.Popup(player, "Info", "🦹 ¡LADRÓN!", { "Quiere tu dinero… o tu caja.", "¡Aléjate o golpéalo (F / espada)!" })
		return
	end
	-- fallback: placeholder de bloques (solo si NO hay ninguna plantilla)
	count(player, 1)
	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Thief", {
		TargetUserId = player.UserId, Speed = 20, CatchDist = 3.5, LifeTime = 16,
	}, CFrame.new(randomSpawnPos(pos, 24, 32)))
	model.Destroying:Connect(function() count(player, -1) end)
	watchCaught(model, function(userId)
		local p = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		local data = p and EconomyService.GetData(p)
		if p and data then
			local stolen = math.min(math.floor(data.Money * 0.1), 100)
			if stolen > 0 then
				EconomyService.AddMoney(p, -stolen)
				DeliveryService.Popup(p, "Fail", "🦹 ¡TE ROBARON!", { "-$" .. stolen })
			else
				DeliveryService.Popup(p, "Info", "🦹 LADRÓN", { "No tenías dinero que robar…" })
			end
		end
	end)
	DeliveryService.Popup(player, "Info", "🦹 ¡LADRÓN!", { "Quiere tu dinero. Aléjate." })
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🚁 DRONE: te hace soltar el paquete
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.SpawnDrone(player)
	local pos = rootPos(player)
	if not pos then return end
	count(player, 1)
	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Drone", {
		TargetUserId = player.UserId, Speed = 30, CatchDist = 4, LifeTime = 12,
	}, CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-15, 15), 10, rng:NextNumber(-15, 15))))
	model.Destroying:Connect(function() count(player, -1) end)
	watchCaught(model, function(userId)
		local p = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		if p then
			DeliveryService.DropPackage(p, "drone")
		end
	end)
	DeliveryService.Popup(player, "Info", "🚁 DRONE", { "Un drone de seguridad te sigue…" })
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 🐔 POLLO: escapa y hay que atraparlo (solo el dueño)
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.SpawnChicken(player, onCaught)
	local pos = rootPos(player)
	if not pos then return end
	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Chicken", {
		TargetUserId = player.UserId, LifeTime = 40,
	}, CFrame.new(randomSpawnPos(pos, 8, 14)))
	watchCaught(model, function(userId)
		if userId == player.UserId then
			onCaught()
		end
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- 👻 ANOMALÍA (evento): persigue al repartidor más cercano
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.SpawnAnomaly(duration)
	local model = EntitySpawner.Spawn("Anomaly", {
		Speed = 24, CatchDist = 4.5, LifeTime = duration,
	}, CFrame.new(0, 4, 0))
	watchCaught(model, function(userId)
		local p = userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		if p and model.PrimaryPart then
			HazardService.Trip(p, model.PrimaryPart.Position)
			DeliveryService.DropPackage(p, "anomaly")
		end
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- BUCLE AMBIENTE: peligros ocasionales para repartidores activos
------------------------------------------------------------
function HazardService.Start()
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(12)
			for player, session in pairs(DeliveryService.Sessions) do
				if player.Parent and (activeCounts[player] or 0) == 0 then
					local pkgId = session.Package.Id
					local roll = rng:NextNumber()
					if roll < 0.10 then
						HazardService.SpawnDog(player)
					elseif roll < 0.16 + ((pkgId == "Public" or pkgId == "Valuable") and 0.14 or 0) then
						HazardService.SpawnThief(player)
					elseif roll < 0.22 then
						HazardService.SpawnDrone(player)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function HazardService.Cleanup(player)
	activeCounts[player] = nil
end

return HazardService

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- 👊 RIG COMBAT (v2) · golpea a los ladrones con F (o con la
-- espada del StarterPack). El servidor valida distancia y daño.
-- Al llegar a 0 HP, el propio RigThief se desvanece solo.
-- v2: con los BRAZOS muy dañados (InjuryArms >= 75) no puedes
--     golpear — a curarse primero (sistema de lesiones).
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local PUNCH_RANGE = 7      -- studs máximos para alcanzar al ladrón
local PUNCH_DAMAGE = 34    -- 3 golpes a un ladrón de 100 HP
local PUNCH_COOLDOWN = 0.6 -- segundos entre golpes por jugador
local ARM_NO_PUNCH_AT = 75 -- % de daño en brazos que impide golpear

-- RemoteEvent propio (dentro de DeliveryRemotes si existe)
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DeliveryRemotes")
if not remotes then
	remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
	remotes.Name = "DeliveryRemotes"
	remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local punch = remotes:FindFirstChild("Punch")
if not punch then
	punch = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	punch.Name = "Punch"
	punch.Parent = remotes
end

-- ladrones vivos: clones del spawner + el Rig original
local function thieves()
	local list = {}
	local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("RigThieves")
	if folder then
		for _, m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			if m:IsA("Model") and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
				table.insert(list, m)
			end
		end
	end
	local rig = workspace:FindFirstChild("Rig")
	if rig and rig:IsA("Model") and rig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
		table.insert(list, rig)
	end
	return list
end

local lastPunch = {}
punch.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastPunch[player] and now - lastPunch[player] < PUNCH_COOLDOWN then return end
	-- 💪 brazos muy dañados no pueden golpear
	if (player:GetAttribute("InjuryArms") or 0) >= ARM_NO_PUNCH_AT then return end
	lastPunch[player] = now
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	-- ladrón vivo más cercano
	local best, bestDist, bestHum
	for _, m in ipairs(thieves()) do
		local hum = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local r = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hum and r and hum.Health > 0 then
			local d = (r.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
			if d <= PUNCH_RANGE and (not bestDist or d < bestDist) then
				best, bestDist, bestHum = m, d, hum
			end
		end
	end
	if not best then return end
	-- daño + empujón
	bestHum:TakeDamage(PUNCH_DAMAGE)
	local r = best:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if r then
		local dir = r.Position - hrp.Position
		dir = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
		if dir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			r:ApplyImpulse(dir.Unit * r.AssemblyMass * 30 + Vector3.new(0, r.AssemblyMass * 12, 0))
		end
	end
	print("[Combat] " .. player.Name .. " golpeó a " .. best.Name .. " (queda " .. math.max(0, math.floor(bestHum.Health)) .. " HP)")
end)

print("[RigCombat] listo — los jugadores golpean con F")

--!nonstrict
--============================================================
-- HUD · temporizador superior, ⏱️ reloj sobre la cabeza, tarjeta
-- del paquete (con ⭐ dificultad), destino (baliza para todos +
-- haz guía con GPS N2), dinero/reputación/nivel, stamina,
-- popups y banner de eventos. Todo construido por código.
-- v2: indicador de lesiones 🩹 bajo la stamina (🦵💪🧠 con %).
--============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local HUD = {}

local refs = {}
local beacon = nil
local beamAnchor, beam, attA = nil, nil, nil
local clockGui, clockLabel = nil, nil
local popupToken = 0

local COLORS = {
	Panel = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 30),
	Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 245),
	Good = Color3.fromRGB(150, 240, 180),
	Warn = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 120),
	Bad = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 100),
	Accent = Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113),
}

local function round(inst, r)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 10)
	c.Parent = inst
end

local function makeLabel(parent, name, size, pos, textSize, font)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Name = name
	l.Size = size
	l.Position = pos
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.TextColor3 = COLORS.Text
	l.Font = font or Enum.Font.Gotham
	l.TextSize = textSize
	l.Text = ""
	l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

local function makePanel(parent, name, size, pos)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = name
	f.Size = size
	f.Position = pos
	f.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.Panel
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.Visible = false
	round(f, 12)
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

function HUD.Build()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "DeliveryHUD"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	refs.Gui = gui

	-- ⏱️ Temporizador (arriba, centro)
	local timerFrame = makePanel(gui, "Timer", UDim2.fromOffset(220, 70), UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0, 14))
	local timerScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	timerScale.Parent = timerFrame

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Popups
------------------------------------------------------------
local POPUP_COLORS = {
	Assigned = Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113),
	Success = Color3.fromRGB(70, 161, 113),
	Fail = Color3.fromRGB(224, 90, 80),
	Info = Color3.fromRGB(90, 110, 140),
}

function HUD.Popup(data)
	local popup = refs.Popup
	if not popup then return end
	popup.BackgroundColor3 = POPUP_COLORS[data.Kind] or COLORS.Panel
	popup.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
	refs.PopupTitle.Text = data.Title or ""
	refs.PopupLines.Text = table.concat(data.Lines or {}, "\n")
	popup.Visible = true
	popupToken += 1
	local myToken = popupToken
	task.delay(3.4, function()
		if popupToken == myToken then
			popup.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Banner de evento
------------------------------------------------------------
function HUD.Event(icon, name, desc, duration)
	local banner = refs.Banner
	if not banner then return end
	refs.BannerLabel.Text = icon .. " " .. name .. " — " .. desc
	banner.Visible = true
	task.delay(math.min(duration or 8, 10), function()
		banner.Visible = false
	end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ⏱️ Reloj flotante sobre la cabeza del repartidor (60 → 0)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function ensureClock(char, on)
	if on and char then
		local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not head then return end
		if not clockGui or clockGui.Parent ~= head then
			if clockGui then clockGui:Destroy() end
			clockGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			clockGui.Name = "DeliveryClock"
			clockGui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(96, 42)
			clockGui.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
			clockGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
			clockLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			clockLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			clockLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			clockLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			clockLabel.TextScaled = true
			clockLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
			clockLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.Good
			clockLabel.Text = "⏱️ 60.0"
			clockLabel.Parent = clockGui
			clockGui.Parent = head
		end
	elseif clockGui then
		clockGui:Destroy()
		clockGui = nil
		clockLabel = nil
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Baliza luminosa en el destino (para TODOS, sin GPS)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function ensureBeacon(on, destPos)
	if on and destPos then
		if not beacon then
			beacon = Instance.new("Part")
			beacon.Name = "DestBeacon"
			beacon.Anchored = true
			beacon.CanCollide = false
			beacon.CanQuery = false
			beacon.CanTouch = false
			beacon.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			beacon.Transparency = 0.35
			beacon.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90)
			beacon.Size = Vector3.new(3, 90, 3)
			beacon.Parent = workspace
		end
		beacon.CFrame = CFrame.new(destPos + Vector3.new(0, 45, 0))
	elseif beacon then
		beacon:Destroy()
		beacon = nil
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Haz guía del jugador al destino (GPS nivel 2+)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function ensureBeam(on, destPos, char)
	if on and destPos and char then
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		if not beamAnchor then
			beamAnchor = Instance.new("Part")
			beamAnchor.Name = "GPSBeamAnchor"
			beamAnchor.Anchored = true
			beamAnchor.CanCollide = false
			beamAnchor.CanQuery = false
			beamAnchor.CanTouch = false
			beamAnchor.Transparency = 1
			beamAnchor.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
			local attB = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attB.Parent = beamAnchor
			beam = Instance.new("Beam")
			beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255))
			beam.Width0 = 0.5
			beam.Width1 = 0.5
			beam.FaceCamera = true
			beam.Attachment1 = attB
			beam.Parent = beamAnchor
			beamAnchor.Parent = workspace
		end
		beamAnchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(destPos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
		if not attA or attA.Parent ~= hrp then
			if attA then attA:Destroy() end
			attA = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attA.Parent = hrp
			beam.Attachment0 = attA
		end
	else
		if beam then beam:Destroy() beam = nil end
		if beamAnchor then beamAnchor:Destroy() beamAnchor = nil end
		if attA then attA:Destroy() attA = nil end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tick por frame: temporizador, reloj, destino, stamina, dinero
------------------------------------------------------------
function HUD.Tick(player)
	if not refs.Gui then return end
	local state = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryState")
	local hasDelivery = state ~= nil and state ~= "None"
	local char = player.Character

	refs.TimerFrame.Visible = hasDelivery
	refs.DestFrame.Visible = hasDelivery

	if hasDelivery then
		local endsAt = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryEndsAt") or 0
		local remaining = math.max(0, endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		local timeText = string.format("%.1f", remaining)
		local timeColor
		if remaining > 20 then
			timeColor = COLORS.Good
			refs.TimerScale.Scale = 1
		elseif remaining > 10 then
			timeColor = COLORS.Warn
			refs.TimerScale.Scale = 1
		else
			timeColor = COLORS.Bad
			refs.TimerScale.Scale = 1 + 0.07 * math.abs(math.sin(os.clock() * 7))
		end
		refs.TimeLabel.Text = timeText
		refs.TimeLabel.TextColor3 = timeColor

		-- ⏱️ reloj sobre la cabeza
		ensureClock(char, true)
		if clockLabel then
			clockLabel.Text = "⏱️ " .. timeText
			clockLabel.TextColor3 = timeColor
		end

		local destName = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryDestName") or "?"
		local destPos = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryDestPos")
		local hasPos = typeof(destPos) == "Vector3"
		local gps = player:GetAttribute("GPSLevel") or 0

		local distText = ""
		if gps >= 1 and hasPos then
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hrp then
				distText = " · " .. math.floor((hrp.Position - destPos).Magnitude + 0.5) .. " studs"
			end
		end
		refs.DestLabel.Text = "📍 " .. destName .. distText

		-- baliza para todos + haz guía con GPS nivel 2
		ensureBeacon(hasPos, destPos)
		ensureBeam(gps >= 2 and hasPos, destPos, char)

		-- tarjeta del paquete con dificultad
		refs.Card.Visible = true
		refs.CardIcon.Text = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryPackageIcon") or "📦"
		local pkgName = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryPackage") or "Paquete"
		local diff = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryDifficulty") or 1
		refs.CardName.Text = pkgName .. " " .. string.rep("⭐", math.clamp(diff, 1, 3))
		refs.CardDesc.Text = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryPackageDesc") or ""
		if state == "Dropped" then
			refs.CardDesc.Text = "📦 ¡En el suelo! Recógelo."
		elseif state == "ChickenOut" then
			refs.CardDesc.Text = "🐔 ¡El pollo escapó! Atrápalo."
		end
		local health = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryHealth") or -1
		refs.HealthLabel.Text = health >= 0 and ("❤️ x" .. health) or ""
	else
		refs.Card.Visible = false
		ensureClock(nil, false)
		ensureBeacon(false)
		ensureBeam(false)
	end

	-- stamina
	local st = player:GetAttribute("Stamina") or 100
	local stMax = player:GetAttribute("StaminaMax") or 100
	refs.StaminaFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(st / math.max(1, stMax), 0, 1), 1)

	-- 🩹 lesiones: se curan solas con el tiempo; sin curar, penalizan
	local legs = player:GetAttribute("InjuryLegs") or 0
	local arms = player:GetAttribute("InjuryArms") or 0
	local head = player:GetAttribute("InjuryHead") or 0
	local parts = {}
	if legs >= 20 then table.insert(parts, "🦵 " .. legs .. "%") end
	if arms >= 20 then table.insert(parts, "💪 " .. arms .. "%") end
	if head >= 20 then table.insert(parts, "🧠 " .. head .. "%") end
	refs.InjuryLabel.Text = #parts > 0 and ("🩹 " .. table.concat(parts, "  ·  ")) or ""

	-- dinero, reputación y nivel
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if ls then
		local money = ls:FindFirstChild("Money")
		local rep = ls:FindFirstChild("Rep")
		local level = ls:FindFirstChild("Level")
		refs.MoneyLabel.Text = "💰 $" .. (money and money.Value or 0)
			.. "  ⭐ " .. (rep and rep.Value or 50)
			.. "  🏆 Nv. " .. (level and level.Value or 1)
	end
end

return HUD
